capabilities: Run natural-language commands to automate vault tasks
Chat with Open Interpreter through an interactive interface
Read, write, and edit Markdown files via AI actions
Detect Open Interpreter installation and guide setup
Require user approval before executing actions
extras: Requires Obsidian v0.15.0+; API keys must be set in settings for the chosen model.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to execute AI-driven automations on vault files through natural language commands.

relations.evidence: This plugin integrates Open Interpreter with Obsidian

summary: AI assistant that runs Open Interpreter in the vault, letting you automate note tasks via natural-language chat commands.
